[SWS_PHM_01347]
{DRAFT}
Switch Elementary Supervision Status from
kOK
to
kFAILED
⌈
If
Elementary Supervision Status
is
kOK
AND the corresponding
supervision is
Alive Supervision
AND a temporary failure is detected, i.e. the
counter for failed Alive Supervision reference cycles is greater than zero but does not
exceed failure tolerance
failedReferenceCyclesTolerance
, THEN the
Plat-
form Health Management
shall change the
Elementary Supervision Sta-
tus
to
kFAILED
.
⌋
(RS_PHM_00111)
See transition (3) in figure 7.5.
